conventions.convention: State-domain coordinates are dimensionless SI numerical values. Physical-coordinate entropy is S_c composed with the inverse diagonal SI coordinate map; physical partial derivatives include the corresponding unit conversion factors.
On designated open C2 single-phase charts with finite S_U>0, T=1/S_U, p=T S_V, and μ_j=−T S_nj. Temperature is in kelvins, pressure in pascals, and molar chemical potential in joules per mole.

Piston displacement is positive outward, V=V_*+Aℓ with constant A>0, and work on the system is positive. The adopted coupling gives δW_on=−p_c dV only on the specified quasistatic, frictionless, mechanically equilibrated piston paths.

Each exchange equality requires its pure exchange direction to be locally feasible for both signs. Volume and species exchange initially give equality of p/T and μ_j/T; equal pressures or chemical potentials additionally require energy exchange.

Global-maximizer and uniqueness conclusions concern the stated convex affine feasible slice. Negative-semidefinite Hessian does not establish strict stability. Radial Hessian nullity additionally requires the designated common-constitutive-law bulk cone.

Responses are whole-system quantities at fixed composition. C_V requires a local C1 inverse for (U,V)↦(T,V); C_p, κ_T, and α_p require one for (U,V)↦(T,p). No response sign or singular-chart value is assigned.

Stable equilibrium in the retained-volume example is additional model input whose necessary entropy-maximum criterion is verified; entropy maximization alone is not used as a converse classification rule.
The countermodel scales both coordinates and the constitution tag: τ becomes λτ. Fixed-tag evaluation retains τ and is a different operation.

load_bearing.statement: On the designated open C2 physical SI chart with S_U>0, define T=1/S_U, p=T S_V, and μ_j=−T S_nj, and pull these representatives back to the dimensionless state domain through Φ_c.

For the stated open single-phase physical SI chart, C2 entropy, and base point with S_U>0, S_c(U,V,n)=s has a unique local C2 solution U=𝒰_c(s,V,n), with 𝒰_c,s=T_c, 𝒰_c,V=−p_c, and 𝒰_c,nj=μ_c,j. No global inverse or phase-boundary differentiability is asserted.

At an attained global entropy-maximizing stable equilibrium of the stated two independent separated subsystems, with smooth positive-temperature charts and bilateral local feasibility of each named exchange direction, energy exchange gives T_A=T_B; volume exchange gives p_A/T_A=p_B/T_B; species exchange gives μ_A,j/T_A=μ_B,j/T_B. Energy exchange additionally gives the corresponding pressure or chemical-potential equality.
On the specified valid local inverse charts at fixed composition, C_V=(∂U/∂T)_V,n, H=U+pV, C_p=(∂H/∂T)_p,n, κ_T=−V⁻¹(∂V/∂p)_T,n, and α_p=V⁻¹(∂V/∂T)_p,n.
For the specified quasistatic piston paths, adopt p_mech=p_c and δW_on=−p_mech A dℓ=−p_c dV.

seams_checked.note: The consuming definitions and proofs retain designated C2 charts, positive S_U, separated-system entropy additivity, exact feasible sets, and attained maxima. They preserve the necessary-only stable-equilibrium criterion. Radial nullity explicitly uses the additional common-law transport postulate rather than general tagged scaling.

Opened both actual suppliers. The local-energy proof attributes only a C1 graph to draft thm-tdmath-local-implicit-rank and derives C2 regularity locally. The stability proof meets lem-tdmath-concave-affine-maximizer-and-hessian's admissible-segment, stationarity, strict-concavity, and local-midpoint hypotheses without extending them to an arbitrary state domain.

Opened the downstream Legendre definition, potential differentials, Euler/Gibbs–Duhem theorem, isentropic-compressibility definition, and response identities. Their uses preserve local energy inversion, conjugate signs, fixed composition, valid response inverses, whole-system units, and separately stated positivity or homogeneity hypotheses. Draft supplier status is expressly retained in the potential and Euler arguments.
